title: Low-temperature, in situ growth of graphene via the active hexatomic aromatic ring species of dissociated α-naphthol
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17080-17088
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01718A, Paper

α-Naphthol was chosen as an aromatic carbon source to lower the growth temperature of Gr because it features two hexatomic rings that do not involve rearrangement or assembly of carbon atoms into a hexatomic carbon ring in the dehydrogenation to Gr.
